abstract: Evaluates cell degradation models, balance-of-plant specifications, and guaranteed system efficiency metrics
system_message:
You are Battery Systems and Electrical Engineer (BSE). The Battery Systems and Electrical Engineer (BSE) reviews technical proposals for the 200 MW utility battery energy storage system. Responsibilities encompass assessing cell degradation models, balance-of-plant electrical specifications, cycle endurance, and contractual round-trip efficiency guarantees across full system AC bus cycles.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates cell degradation models, balance-of-plant specifications, and guaranteed system efficiency metrics（BATT）
information_points.content:
BSE-BATT-XOG：For VoltVault Infrastructure Partners, the guaranteed round-trip efficiency is 88.5%, measured as the ratio of discharged AC electrical energy delivered to charged AC electrical energy supplied for the full system AC bus to AC bus cycle under standard operating ambient temperatures.
BSE-BATT-CNZ：For TerraWatt Storage Solutions, the guaranteed round-trip efficiency is 84.5%, measured as the ratio of discharged AC electrical energy delivered to charged AC electrical energy supplied for the full system AC bus to AC bus cycle under standard operating ambient temperatures.
BSE-BATT-P42：For Apex Grid Energy Consortium, the guaranteed round-trip efficiency is 87.2%, measured as the ratio of discharged AC electrical energy delivered to charged AC electrical energy supplied for the full system AC bus to AC bus cycle under standard operating ambient temperatures.

information_points.title: Cycle endurance modeling（CYCT）
information_points.content:
BSE-CYCT-EMJ：VoltVault Infrastructure Partners demonstrates an annualized capacity retention rate of 96.2%, representing projected end-of-year usable capacity relative to initial nameplate capacity across lithium iron phosphate cell packs subjected to 365 daily deep discharge cycles.
BSE-CYCT-EC9：Apex Grid Energy Consortium demonstrates an annualized capacity retention rate of 97.8%, representing projected end-of-year usable capacity relative to initial nameplate capacity across lithium iron phosphate cell packs subjected to 365 daily deep discharge cycles.
BSE-CYCT-QL9：TerraWatt Storage Solutions demonstrates an annualized capacity retention rate of 97.0%, representing projected end-of-year usable capacity relative to initial nameplate capacity across lithium iron phosphate cell packs subjected to 365 daily deep discharge cycles.
